description: Returns the list of tags for each artist together with its description (HTML) if available. In addition to all the common query parameters of the parent 'artists' method, this endpoint supports filtering by a single tag using the 'tag' parameter. The response can be formatted as XML, JSON, or pretty‑printed JSON.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wrap the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, max 200. The keyword 'all' is capped at 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the specified field(s). Append _asc or _desc to set direction; ascending is default except for popularity orders which force descending.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, the response header includes the total number of rows that would be returned without limit/offset. Use sparingly as it impacts performance.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One or more artist IDs (can be repeated).

parameters.name: namesearch
parameters.description: Search an artist by name using a wildcard pattern.

parameters.name: hasimage
parameters.description: Return only artists that have an image.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Filter on the artist joining date using a closed interval formatted as yyyy-mm-dd_yyyy-mm-dd.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Filter artists by a single tag. Results are returned in relevance order unless another order is specified.

notes: Only one tag can be used for filtering; multiple tags are not supported.
Popularity based order fields always sort descending, even if _asc is requested.
Setting fullcount=true can significantly affect response time on large result sets.
